title: Strategies for Prioritizing and Paying Off Debt
content: Prioritizing debt is critical for regaining financial control. Two primary strategies exist: 1. Debt Avalanche Method: Pay minimums on all obligations, while channeling extra funds into the debt with the highest interest rate (such as credit cards or high-interest personal loans). This mathematically minimizes total interest paid. 2. Debt Snowball Method: Focus extra payments on the smallest balance first for psychological momentum. High-interest unsecured debts should generally be tackled before low-interest tax-advantaged debts like home loans.
